# Compose file for a local stack
version: "3.9"
x-defaults: &defaults
  restart: unless-stopped
  logging:
    driver: json-file
    options: { max-size: "10m", max-file: "3" }

services:
  api:
    <<: *defaults
    image: ghcr.io/example/agentry:latest
    ports:
      - "8787:8787"
      - 9229:9229
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      DEBUG: 'false'
      WORKERS: 4
      RATIO: 0.5
      EMPTY: ~
      ENABLED: yes
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data:rw
      - claude-config:/home/node/.claude
    command: ["node", "dist/server.js", "--port", "8787"]
    healthcheck:
      test: curl -fsS http://localhost:8787/api/health || exit 1
      interval: 30s
    depends_on: [db]
  db:
    <<: *defaults
    image: postgres:16
    env_file: .env # secrets live here
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits: {cpus: '0.50', memory: 512M}

volumes:
  claude-config: {}
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: agentry
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: agentry
spec:
  replicas: 2
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: "ghcr.io/example/agentry:1.2.3"
          args:
            - --verbose
            - --timeout=30
          script: >-
            echo folded
            text here
          notes: |
            literal block
              keeps indentation
      nodeSelector: null
      tolerations: []
      dates: 2026-09-19
